PURPOSE: Execution-boundary contract for worker execution isolation: sandbox object model, typed lifecycle state machine (Running/Paused/Snapshotting/Killed), capability envelope at create (egress allow/deny with allow-beats-deny, TTL, metadata attribution), credential-broker-at-egress pattern (secrets metadata-only, injected outside the boundary), at-least-once signed lifecycle receipts with dedupe IDs, and kill_reason enums that preserve UNKNOWN. Feeds proofs 9-12 (worker execution isolation) via the sealed execution-receipt contract; not the sandbox fleet itself.
SMALLEST_MISSING_PRIMITIVE: A sealed execution-receipt contract at the worker boundary: ExecutionAttempt{execution_id, mission_id, capability_envelope{allowed_egress, denied_egress, max_wall_ms, on_timeout: kill|checkpoint}, secrets:'metadata-only', started_at} + ExecutionReceipt{execution_id, exit_code|null, stdout_digest, stderr_digest, kill_reason: request|timeout|admin|orphaned|unknown, execution_time_ms, ended_at}. Bindings: proof 10 = receipt with exit_code 0; proof 11 = verifier checks receipt digests/binding, never the worker's claim; proof 12 = new execution_id under same mission_id; proof 13 = verifier consumes the receipt stream; proof 14 = event-sourced receipts with bounded retention. Failure semantics from E2B: 503 pause-refusal keeps the sandbox running (never fail-closed on transient); kill_reason 'unknown' preserves UNKNOWN.
